content: Ibmar-welesad unnigualed

Moisés sogdebalid: “Degisoggu, Bezaleel, Aholiabʼbogwa, Bab-Jehová-sogsagusadba Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-selegedgi ibmar-ebulemalad bela imakmaloed. Deginbali, bela dulemar, Bab-Jehová nue-wisi-ibmar-sobega-imaksamarmogadi, degi, ega baisursunna-ibmar-imakega-imaklesbalidi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged-sobega, wemar-ebogwadba arbamarmogoed.”
Moisés, we-dulemarse gochad:

Moisés we-dulemarga Israel-dulemar-ibmarmar-senonikid uksad. Adi, agi we-dulemar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-selegedgi ibmar-ebulemaloed sobegar. Israel-dulemala na e-itolegedba bane-bane wakudaryalaba Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukega ibmarmar senonidamalad.
Bela-dulemar-ibmar-sobnanaid deyob dakdegua, e-arbaed indaksamalad.
Geb Moisésʼga sognadmalad: “Dulemar Bab-Jehová-sogsadba-ibmar-sobega ibmar-berbelemaid doggus wilub-obichagusad. Emide, ibmar ise-obinagwaled.”
Degisoggu, Moisés dulemar-bukwadse gaya-barmisad: “Machergan, degi, omegan, Bab-Dummad-neg-sobega melle bar ibmar amimalo, melle bar Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar sedamalo.”
Ar ibmar-sobmalaga, bato ibmarmar unnigualed. Ar ise-obinagwarsoggu, dulemar ibmar-baid bar senonisurmalad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged soblesad

Bela dulemar-arbananaid, napiragwad-bur-ibmar-sobmalad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged sobsamalad. We-dulemar, linoʼdub-nuedgi, nirbadub-aradgi, nirbadub-suir-akwagiidgi, degi, nirbadub-ginnidgi mor-dummagan-goambe (10) sobsamalad. Agi baliwitur-dummagan-querubinʼye-nugad bela nue-yeerdakle-imakar mor-dummagangi-nai sobsamarbalid.
Mormar-e-sugued, daligugledbi (7) imaksamalad, e-matardungueddi, daligwenadbi imaksamalad. Mormala bela emarbi-dungu imaksamalad.
Mormar-dummagan goatale gwadismalad, amba deyob baid goatale gwadismarbalid.
Degine, mor-goataled-gwadialed-e-dikargi e-uayamar dub-aradgi ega nasiklesad. Amba deyob mormar-baigan goatarmalad-gwadiarmalad-e-dikargi nasiklesbalid.
Mormar-gebedgi gwadulabo-gakambe (50) e-uayamar nasiksamalad. Degine, baigan-goatar-gwadiarmaladgi gwadulabo-gakambe (50) e-uayamar nasiksamarbalid. Degisoggu, e-uayamar na abin-abin nasiklesad.
Deginbali, mor-gaed-orbiid dulabo-gakambe (50) sobsamarbalid. Agi mormar oatosmalad. Degisoggu, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged-e-mor-dummagan unnila gogwenayob gunonisunnad.
We-dulemar, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged-edugega, sibad-absarmargi mor-dummagan sobsamalad. Sibad-absarmar mor-dummaganga goambe-gakagwensak (11) imaksamalad.
Mormar-dummagan-goambe-gakagwensakad (11) bela na-emarbi-dungu imaksamalad. Mormar-e-sugued, daligugle-gaka-abala (7½) sugued. E-matardungueddi, daligwenad.
We-mormar-dummagan, goatar gwadismalad. Degine, baiddi, goanergwa (6) gwadismalad.
Geb a-sorba, mor-dummagan-goatar-gwadilealed-dikarba, gwadulabo-gakambe (50) e-uayamar nasiksamalad. Amba deyob baigan-gwadilesmalad-dikarba, gwadulabo-gakambe (50) e-uayamar nasiksamarbalid.
Deginbali, esgoro-gordikidgi mor-gaed dulabo-gakambe (50) soblesbalid, adi, agi bela neg-edugegar, unnila gogwennayob gunonisunnad.

Geb degine, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged-edugega, sibad-wawaad-machered-e-ukamar-ginnidgi-odolegaled, gwadi-gwadi imaksamarbalid. Adi, sibad-absarmor-dummagan-birgi ogillegegar. Geb sibad-wawaad-machered-e-ukamar-ginnidgi-odolegaled-birgi ogillegega, ibdurgan-uka-nuegan gwadi-gwadi imaksamarbalid.
Deginbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-selegedga urgomar-acaciaʼye-nugad sobsamalad. We-urgomala, bela nue-innikii ogwichismalad.
We-urgomar, dalibo-abala-sugu imaksamalad. E-matardungueddi, achapaa-nika imaksamalad.
We-urgomargi, e-nagmar war-warbo-nika imaksamalad, adi, nabir urgomar naga-nagaba matak-matak gwisguegar. Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-selegedga bela degibi urgomar imaksamalad.
Weyob Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-selegedga urgomar-mergu imaksamalad: Mata-dulagwen (20) dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik-ebugegar.
We-urgomar-dulagwenad-urba (20), dulabo (40) e-sigmalad manibi sobsad. Urgomar-irbali gwa-gwabo e-sigmalad imaksamalad, adi, urgomar-e-nagmar agi odogegar.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-ebugegala, urgomar-dulagwen (20) sobsamarbalid.
E-sigmalad, manibii gwadulabo (40) sobsamarbalid. Urgomar-iliba, gwa-gwabo e-sigmalad sobsamalad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged dad-argwanedsikidga urgomar-matanergwa (6) sobsamalad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged na abingunanaidga urgomar-matabo sobsamarbalid.
We-urgomar darbo oatosmalad. Geb birgi e-nonogi or-dummad-naid yosmalad, adi, melle bar urgo-matabogwad-ungega, weyobi imaksamalad.
Degisoggu, urgomar bela matabaabak (8) sobsamalad, e-siged-mani-biid gwaambe-gakanergwa (16) sobsamalad. Bela urgomar-iliba, e-sigmalad gwa-gwabo sobsamalad.
Deginbali, urgo-warakwagana-acaciaʼye-nugad sobsamarbalid: Urgo-warakwagana-walatar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged-e-dikar-soggwensikidga sobsamalad.
Degine, baid-dikarsikidga, walatar sobsamarbalid, degine, e-dikar-yargansikid-dad-argwanedsikidga urgo-warakwagana walatar sobsamarbalid.
Urgomar-ebilis egi ormar matak-matak nasiksamalad, degine, e-olua-dummagandi orbi sobsamalad. Degine, Urgo-warakwagana-ebilis egi ormar matak-matak nasiksamarbalid.

Deginbali, mor-dummad nirbadub-aradgi, nirbadub-suir-akwagiidgi, nirbadub-ginnidgi, degi, linoʼdub-nuedgi sobsamalad. We-mor-dummadde nue-yeerdakle-imakar, baliwiturmar-querubinʼye-nugad egi-sobar imaksamalad.

We-mor-dummad-nasikegala, acacia-buarmar-walabake ogwichismalad. A-buarmar-ebilis, egi ormar matak-matak nasiksamalad. Degine, mor-gamalad bela orbi sobsabalid. Deginbali, buarmar-e-gaed, adi, gwabake manibi sobsad.

Deginbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged-yawagakga mor-dummad imaksamarbalid, nirbadub-aradgi, nirbadub-suir-akwagiidgi, nirbadub-ginnidgi, degi, linoʼdub-nuedgi imaksamalad. We-mor-dummadde, nue-yeerdakle imakaled.
A-yawagakgindi, buarmar-walatar ogwichismalad, degine, mor-gamalad sobsabalid. A-buarmar-ebilis egi ormar matak-matak nasiksad, degine, e-siged-gwaataledi, esgoro-gordikidgi sobsad.
